name: lightweight-change
description: Bounded understand/change/verify path for routine work: read the real code, make the smallest correct change, and run focused verification. Owns simple changes; structured multi-phase work stays in SDD.
abstract: A bounded understand/change/verify lifecycle for routine work. Composes the bug-diagnosis, impact-analysis, and Nix methods when useful, creates no SDD artifacts, and keeps exactly one lifecycle owner per task with SDD reserved for structured multi-phase work.
